groundTruth.rootCause: Product image requests through frontend-proxy are delayed by 5sec; image-provider itself stays fast.
acceptableAlternatives: image requests are delayed before they reach image-provider

hypothesis: Envoy fault injection in frontend-proxy adds a ~5 s delay to product image requests (/images/products/*), most likely because the imageSlowLoad flag is on. The backends are not involved: image-provider answers right away, and the delay is added in the proxy, which pushes frontend-proxy p95 from ~36 ms to ~4 s starting at 04:52.
